title: Sunflower 125kW / 261kWh PV Hybrid ESS
summary: An integrated PV hybrid energy storage system combining 125kW backup output with 261kWh-class battery capacity.

specs.label: Cycle life
specs.value: 6,000 cycles @ 80% SOH (25 °C / 0.5C); up to 8,000 at cell level

faqs.question: How much PV can it take?
faqs.answer: Up to 250 kW usable PV input against a 261 kWh battery, roughly two to one.

faqs.question: What is the cycle life?
faqs.answer: 6,000 cycles to 80% state of health at 25°C and 0.5C; cell level is rated up to 8,000.

faqs.question: Can it be installed outdoors?
faqs.answer: Yes, IP54 with C4 corrosion protection and liquid cooling.
